description.text: Startuplab is Norway’s leading incubator, accelerator, and investor for early-stage tech startups. With locations in Oslo and Bergen, we support founders with funding, mentorship, workspaces, and a strong network of partners to help them scale globally.

targetApplicants.text: A 3-month sprint with top founders, investors, and experts to sharpen your edge and scale fast.
